organization.name_ja: 株式会社ミスターマックス

affected.note: Maximum number of MrMax app and online store members registered as of 2026-10-03. The items involved vary by member. The company said passwords, credit card data, addresses, birthdates and purchase history were not leaked.

summary.en: Discount retailer Mr Max noticed suspicious access to the servers of its MrMax app and online store on the evening of 2026-10-03 and suspended both services. It announced that a third party had misused a function of the service software to get in, and that member IDs, names, email addresses and phone numbers of up to 1,735,154 members had leaked.
summary.ja: ミスターマックスは2026年10月3日夕方、「MrMaxアプリ」とオンラインストアのサーバーへの不審なアクセスを確認し、両サービスを停止した。第三者がサービスを構成するソフトウェアの機能を不正に利用して侵入し、最大1,735,154名の会員ID、氏名、メールアドレス、電話番号が外部に流出したと発表した。
